headline: AsFloat64Slow benchmark now runs per-quantity sub-benchmarks using b.Loop
summary: The benchmark was rewritten from a single modulo-indexed loop into b.Run sub-benchmarks, one per quantity from the expanded benchmarkQuantities, using b.Loop. It is test-only and affects only benchmark reporting, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
reason: Benchmark-only restructuring in a _test.go file; it cannot affect production behavior and no assertions were removed.
